title: Calculate Running Total
learning_objective: Learn how a window SUM can accumulate totals over time.

tutorial.explanation: A running total sums all rows up to the current row based on date order.
tutorial.syntax: SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on) AS running_total
tutorial.mental_model: The window grows from the first date to the current date.

guided_example.prompt: Calculate a running total by date.
guided_example.solution_query: SELECT visited_on, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on) AS running_total FROM daily_amounts;
guided_example.explanation: Each row adds the current amount to the sum of all previous dates.

practice.expected_query: SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on) AS running_total FROM daily_amounts;
